transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I’m just tired all the time. I know what the normal teacher-at-the-end-of-the-day tired feels like, but it's not that. It's like, even after a full night’s sleep, I have to really push myself through grading, making dinner, and just getting ready for the next morning.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, or that it’s hard to get interested in activities, even things you used to like?

Yeah, I have. Um, most days I can still smile for my students and get through the lessons alright. But underneath, it feels like there’s this... this gray, flat feeling that just follows me home. And when I have free time, even my garden or my watercolors—things I used to really enjoy—they just seem kind of far away now.
Do you find that you often feel down, depressed, or hopeless, even when there's no clear reason for it?

Yeah, I do. I mean... I don't feel like things are falling apart, exactly. It's not some big crisis. But I just have a really hard time believing I'm going to feel lighter anytime soon. It's hard to picture getting back to being the person who actually looked forward to things like going to museums, or starting new projects, or just enjoying quiet afternoons. It just sort of feels like this is how things are now.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt a noticeable loss of energy or increased fatigue, even after resting?

Yeah, that's actually what I meant earlier when I was explaining why I came in. It's been really noticeable lately. Even if I get a completely full night of sleep, I still wake up feeling drained. I just have to constantly force myself to get through my grading, figure out dinner, and get things ready for the next morning. It's definitely not just the normal exhaustion you get from teaching.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes there. My appetite is pretty much the same as always. I still eat my regular meals, and my weight hasn't fluctuated or anything.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?
No, I don't think so. I haven't noticed feeling restless or moving any slower than usual. I mean, I'm tired, like I said, but physically I think I'm moving around at my normal pace.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you're not good enough even when there's no clear reason for it?

Yeah, I do feel that way a lot lately. I just keep thinking I should be handling everything better. Like, sometimes my lesson plans take twice as long to get through, or I have to say no to mentoring a newer teacher... and when I do things like that, I just tell myself I’m letting my family and my school down. I just feel like I'm not doing a good enough job.
Have you experienced episodes like this before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way for an extended period?

No, I don't think I've had episodes like this before. I mean, I've had stressful weeks at school, sure, but... feeling this down for such a long stretch of time? This is really the first time it's been quite like this.
Have you ever experienced a period of time before this one where you felt down, tired, and lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
No, not that I can remember. Like I was just saying, this is really the first time it's been this bad for this long. I've never had a stretch of two weeks or more where I felt like this before.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy for more than two weeks in a row?
I'm sorry, I feel like you just asked me that. But no, I haven't. Like I said, I've never felt this way for two weeks or more before this current stretch. This is the first time it's been like this.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this current one where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy for more than two weeks in a row?
I... I really don't know how else to say it. You keep asking me the same thing, and the answer is still no. I've never had a time like this before. It's just this one time.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy for more than two weeks in a row? Please think carefully, even if it was a shorter time or not quite as severe as now.

I... look, I am thinking carefully about it. But even if it was a shorter amount of time, or not quite as severe, my answer is still no. I know you're trying to be thorough, but I really just haven't ever felt like this before now.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy for more than two weeks in a row? Please think carefully, even if it was a shorter time or not quite as severe as now.

I feel like we're going in circles here. You just asked me that exact same question. My answer hasn't changed... no, I haven't. I've never had a period like this before now, even a mild one. I really don't have a different answer to give you.
Have you ever felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy for more than two weeks in the past, even if it was not exactly like what you’re experiencing now?

I really don't know how to make it any clearer. No. The answer is still no. Before this current stretch started, I never went through anything like that... not for two weeks, not even in a milder way. This is the first and only time I've ever dealt with feeling this way.
How long has it been since these symptoms first started, from the time you noticed the low mood, loss of interest, and fatigue?

It's been... about two years and two months now. It started right around the time my husband stopped working outside the home. Our whole household routine changed back then, and that's really when I first noticed feeling this way.
Have you had any periods of relief from these symptoms that lasted for several weeks or more, or have they been present almost every day since they started two years ago?

No, there hasn't been any break. It's been pretty much every day for those two years and two months. I haven't had any stretches where I felt back to normal or anything like that. It's just been a constant thing since it started.
